title: Automated volumetry of meningiomas in contrast-enhanced T1-Weighted MRI using deep learning.
summary: Transfer-learned ResNet-101 DeepLabV3 segments contrast-enhancing meningiomas on T1 MRI; 255 patient MRIs entered development/test, with manual neurosurgeon contours as reference. Test tumor Dice averaged 0.923 ± 0.051 and volume RMSPE 9.5 ± 1.2%.
ai_technology: MRI segmentation against blinded/manual expert contours; paper notes failures for atypical tumor appearance and limited external generalization.
organization: Department of Neurosurgery, Osaka University Graduate School of Medicine, Suita, Osaka, Japan

evidence.tested: Transfer-learned ResNet-101 DeepLabV3 segments contrast-enhancing meningiomas on T1 MRI; 255 patient MRIs entered development/test, with manual neurosurgeon contours as reference. Test tumor Dice averaged 0.923 ± 0.051 and volume RMSPE 9.5 ± 1.2%.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
